artifacts.name: Leader
artifacts.role: Leader, neural bracer with palm relic
artifacts.review: Body/cloak baseline and weapon direction owner-locked; latest weapon rendering awaits visual verdict.
artifacts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. EDIT this approved alien leader character sheet. The owner has LOCKED THE ENTIRE CHARACTER, including the transparent brain, exact face and three eyes, crown, dreads, skin, body, clothing, sigil, augmentations, feet and the current sculpted three-panel astral cloak. Preserve them all. Only replace the sceptre and adjust the hand/forearm needed for the replacement. Preserve sheet composition and all other views.

OWNER WEAPON DESIGN: "he has a bracer kind of thing that uses his nerves impulses to navigate a weapon in his palm like a small unique looking relic."

Remove the entire sceptre, shaft and floating broken tip in every view. His existing right forearm now carries a close-fitting organic cybernetic bracer, grown into his locked body-augmentation design rather than strapped-on armour. Three low-profile nacre scale plates over deep violet material; beneath small clear gaps we see very fine golden nerve fibres running from the forearm to the wrist and into the palm. These neural filaments echo the visible nerves of his transparent brain. No exposed wound, cables dangling outside the arm, electronics screen or bulky wrist gun.

The hand is naturally open palm-up. Hovering 3-5 cm above it is ONE PHYSICAL palm-sized alien relic weapon, approximately 10-12 cm long, no larger than the palm. It is a compact asymmetrical broken lozenge shaped like an ancient pointed seal: three tightly nested sculptural nacre wedges around a small dark violet core; one crisp split through the object lets a fine amber seam shine through. Clear strong silhouette, one tapered chisel-like point, solid designed object rather than a generic gemstone, orb, ring or scattered crystals. Its form subtly shares the BROKEN rhythm of his chest sigil but does not duplicate a religious trident. Relic's three pieces remain tightly assembled as one object, not a swarm. Nerve impulses in the bracer visibly answer through two very subtle curved amber traces between wrist/palm and the hovering relic. This suggests neural steering without turning it into a hologram. No projected toy soldiers, no interface, no magic smoke. Show the same relic size and shape in the full body and the lower-right closeup. Closeup makes the bracer-to-nerve-to-relic relationship understandable.

Main fullbody stays same pose except for that wrist and open hand. Upper-right portrait and lower-centre back view stay unchanged. Exact source palette and highly detailed rendered concept finish. Dark neutral backdrop. No text, labels, extra characters, added weapons or redesigned garments. The relic and bracer are the ONLY design change.

artifacts.prompt:
Create ONE original Kindred Siege PAL character concept sheet, matching the supplied APPROVED LEADER as a SPECIES/MATERIAL/ART-STYLE reference. This is a DIFFERENT individual, not a leader repaint. The character is one of the leader's trusted injured inner-circle survivors, permanently stationed at camp as an upgrader; depict a capable specialist at work, not a combat hero. He/she shares the leader's ascended cybernetic organism biology and cultural design locks. Dark neutral warm-grey studio backdrop, exact detailed rendered concept-art finish and lighting quality as reference. No game screenshot, no pixel conversion yet.

SHARED LOCKS: same pearl/opal mosaic skin with muted lilac/petrol iridescence and amber seams (never recolour the whole body to an archetype colour); visible organic-integrated rib/limb augmentations; exactly THREE eyes, TWO lateral and ONE vertical forehead eye; the WHOLE upper brain is transparent living anatomy with fine amber neural structure beneath clear normal-sized cranium, broken nacre rim, no huge brain or gore; long aged pale-tipped dreadlocks; mature original alien facial anatomy, no human ears/nose makeover, no mask; realistic adult heroic roughly seven-head proportions, strong shoulders and narrow waist as appropriate for this individual's physique; embodied violet/nacre clothing leaving some body augmentations visible, modest opaque torso/hip coverage; shared broken cult-sigil on a small chest section. Headgear and structured layered astral back-mantle use the leader's split-arch/nacre vocabulary but each Pal has a distinct lower-ranked variation, not the leader's identical huge crown or cape. No moth wings, feathers, round halo, earthly shoes, shorts, enormous pauldrons, exposed viscera or copied Warhammer insignia.
Warhammer Chaos archetypes are emotional/personality influences ONLY. These four belong to ONE original alien people, never demons or direct copies of the Chaos gods. They are comrades with cheeky personalities, not enemies.
Shared-log injuries are known but individual amputations are NOT assigned: show healed stress seams and discreet rehabilitation supports; do not invent severed limbs or exact injury canon. Their intelligence and agency stay central.
COMPOSITION: landscape sheet with large fullbody/mostly fullbody character at a minimal camp workstation on LEFT; expressive close-up portrait upper RIGHT; one clear tool/material detail lower RIGHT. Different individual personality visible at thumbnail size. Keep all three views consistent. Tiny readable heading with working name and camp job only, no paragraph or invented lore.

PAL ONE — "BUTCHER" / "FORGE".
Adult masculine war-smith. War and rage translate into hard focus, blunt impatience and pride in perfect gear. Broad square upper silhouette, massive but anatomically plausible forearms, powerful upper body and tapered waist; do not make him an obese daemon or a space marine. Distinct face: wide jaw, heavy straight brow, closed-mouth dry irritated half-smirk rather than the leader's solemn stare; all three amber eyes intact. Thick long dreadlocks swept behind and tied in a practical loose bundle, two pale thick jaw braids. Headgear a low broken rectangular arch with short upward shoulders, clearly different from the leader's tall crescent. Same transparent brain.
Embodied deep plum chest covering and long split forge-apron panels grown from the waist, pearl skin/augments visible at shoulders and ribs. A small controlled burnt-copper/ember accent in the work gear, not red skin. Compact stepped mantle folded close behind.
He leans at a waist-high levitating forge block, holding a tribal blade in one precision clamp gauntlet and aligning a squat impact-forging tool with his other hand. The tribal steel and the cultured nacre augmentation visibly meet in the workpiece: he upgrades others' equipment. Few amber forge sparks only. Tool shapes readable; no giant warrior axe, horns, skull necklaces, occult chaos emblems or battlefield. Camp support brace visible at waist/forearm without specifying missing limbs. Portrait should show a tough trusted friend with a short fuse and deadpan humour. Workstation is a small supporting prop, not a busy environment.

PAL TWO — "SHADE" / "ORDERS".
An adult FEMALE priest-shaman and brilliant schemer, responsible for teaching/unlocking new battle orders from camp. Traits: change, foresight, tricks, ambition, dry wit. She is clearly a different woman of the SAME species, not a feminized copy of the leader's face and not a human woman in an alien suit.
Tall athletic heroic body with strong shoulders, narrow waist and long elegant limbs. Same pearl/opal mosaic skin and violet-gold augmentations. Distinct high cheekbones, longer angular chin, raised lateral brow ridge and a subtle knowing closed-mouth smile. Exactly two lateral amber eyes and one VERTICAL forehead eye, all readable. Transparent normal-sized brain and fine amber pathways, not a glowing opaque crystal. Long aged pale-tipped dreads arranged in two broad side bundles with several finer prayer braids trailing down, no human hair. Her lower-ranked split-arch headgear is asymmetric: one narrow ascending nacre arm and one short stepped arm, framing rather than hiding her brain, no horns or bird beak.
Embodied layered violet priestly tabard with opaque upper torso coverage and a long divided lower drape, integrated into the flank augments; a compact geometric back-mantle in the same species style, no wings. She has a light rehabilitation support at one elbow and subtle healed seams without inventing an amputation.
At a low camp ritual lectern, she sits upright on an austere sculpted stool, placing three solid small rune weights in a deliberate sequence along a segmented circular order-diagram hovering just above a slate. Her other hand subtly changes one branching path with two fingers. This is her work: interpreting and refining COMMANDS; not firing a spell or fighting. Show disciplined contained energy in amber and a tiny restrained cool violet accent, never a wall of unreadable glowing holograms or random floating objects. No card deck. Close-up shows a few large deliberate carved command glyphs on the physical slate and her hand rearranging a rune, not written game mechanics.
She should feel uncannily perceptive, cheeky and hard to fool, a trusted friend who clearly knows something the leader does not. Avoid Warhammer Tzeentch bird anatomy, blue skin, feathers, extra limbs, demon mouths, staff covered in eyes, literal WoW priest robes, hood hiding the face, horror mutation, human beauty makeup, revealing pinup styling. Same mature premium concept finish as the reference. Make her face unmistakably distinct from the male leader and Butcher while retaining the identical species anatomy.

PAL THREE — "GLUTTON" / "ARMOUR & AUGMENTS".
Adult masculine camp armourer and biological augmentation specialist. Archetype traits: rot, endurance, appetite, the cycle of breakdown and renewal. A stubbornly resilient and perversely cheerful trusted friend, not a horror monster. He enjoys making broken things survive. The owner explicitly chose armour and body augments as his camp responsibility.
ONE SECOND HOOK: a broad solid barrel-ribbed opalescent alien with a heavy crescent of gathered white-tipped dreads around his neck, carefully repairing a tiny damaged plate with surprisingly delicate hands. Broader rounded torso than leader/Butcher, strong arms, a modest solid belly and grounded proportions, never an obese bloated Nurgle copy. Distinct aged broad face, rounded cheek planes, broad flat jaw, one slightly raised amused mouth corner and reassuring knowing gaze. Same exact skin palette, no green skin, boils, ulcers, exposed guts, maggots or fly motifs. Exactly three eyes, forehead eye vertical. Entire normal-sized brain transparent, amber nerve structure. Long thick opal-tipped dreadlocks gather into a heavy beard-like collar then trail behind; keep them visibly dreads, not tentacles. Low double-stepped broken arch headgear curves around the skull, original and less tall than leader's.
The body visibly has OLD REPAIRS: nacre skin plates neatly joined with fine copper seams and grown ribs reinforced in orderly concentric layers. No newly invented missing limbs. A deep plum embodied torso wrap and three shorter layered back panels; same cultural broken sigil. Same beautiful visible cyborg anatomy, not a fully clothed blacksmith or bulky mechanical suit.
He sits at a broad low repair bench in a supportive sculpted camp chair. One supported hand holds an armour plate with an obvious crack; the other uses a fine living-nacre applicator to bridge the crack with a luminous amber seam. Beside it, one detached compact replacement forearm shell demonstrates the body-augment role, clean inactive equipment rather than a severed body part. Two sealed transparent small bioculture capsules sit on the bench: spent dark material below, fresh pearlescent repair fibres above, suggesting decomposition converted into resilience. A tiny muted olive cast within the capsules ONLY, never recolour his skin or clothes. A few old repaired plates are orderly stacked.
Close-up lower right shows damaged armour being joined to grown augmentation tissue through a transparent coupling with amber nerve filaments, no surgery or blood. Make durability and repair immediately clear. Portrait warm but formidable, a darkly funny survivor; avoid a cartoon glutton eating food, demon antlers, plague symbols, medieval apron, human face, duplicate leader crown/face, extra arms or overgrown plants attached to him. Do NOT copy the leader's floating relic weapon into this sheet. He works with repairs and cultures, not command weapons.

PAL FOUR — "WHISPERER" / "SKINS & REGALIA".
A mature androgynous alien court artisan, charming, proud, sensuous in bearing but fully clothed appropriately, with an obsessive eye for perfection. The owner explicitly chose skins and regalia as this Pal's upgrade responsibility. "Skins" means cosmetic APPEARANCES of equipment, never literal removed flesh. The archetype is excess, charm and perfectionism. This Pal is a trusted witty survivor, not a demon or villain.
ONE SECOND HOOK: a poised tall opalescent artisan adjusting an elaborate suspended regalia panel with impossibly exact fingers, while giving the viewer an amused, slightly disdainful look. The figure is strong-shouldered and athletic but longer and narrower than Butcher/Glutton. Distinct long oval alien face, pronounced sloping cheek planes and a small controlled asymmetrical smile, not the leader's squared solemn face. Exactly three amber eyes: two elongated lateral eyes, one vertical forehead eye. Whole normal-sized brain fully transparent with fine amber neural contours. Same pearl/opal mosaic skin, violet/copper implants and embodied clothing; do not recolour skin pink/purple.
Long aged opal-tipped dreadlocks are groomed into five clearly organized ropes swept over one shoulder, with thinner long temple strands and small paired jaw locks; beautiful age and deliberation, not human straight hair or tentacles. Headgear must be DIFFERENT from leader: a LOW horizontal split diadem of narrow stepped nacre pieces framing the lower sides of the clear cranium, with one short upright sliver. No large crescent crown, no horns, no baroque tower, no chaos emblem.
Embodied deep-plum tabard with the same small broken cult sigil, layered waist coverage and a finely proportioned three-panel astral mantle. The cultural family is identical but the fit, engraved border and interrupted edge-rhythm show an artisan's refinement. No expensive jewelry obsession: supremacy and achievement rather than money define their culture. No corset, fetishwear, nudity, human high heels, ordinary shoes, demon claws or pinup pose.
Camp task: leaning comfortably against a supportive atelier seat beside a narrow vertical levitating FRAME holding a translucent violet/nacre mantle panel. One hand uses a flat engraved finishing comb/stylus, the other spreads the suspended panel with fine controlled nerve-linked gestures. A quiet amber ripple changes the finish along a narrow band from matte violet to opalescent ceremonial edging. Two almost identical rejected small regalia samples sit neatly on the bench, a subtle sign of obsessive perfectionism. No large UI or holographic army. Lower-right detail depicts this surface finishing and the placement of a BROKEN cult insignia on the cosmetic panel. This is customization of clothes and equipment, not changing characters' anatomy or granting combat stats.
Small visible support brace on one wrist and healed seams fit an injured camp survivor; no assigned missing limb. Expressive portrait should feel like a witty friend who can flatter you while silently judging your cape. Do not copy Slaanesh, Keeper of Secrets bodies, crab claws, hooves, horns, extra arms, erotic costumes or Warhammer imagery. Do not copy the leader's handheld floating weapon. Standout silhouette from lower diadem, swept dreads, refined vertical mantle and the suspended atelier frame.
